name: FrameBoost
description: PvP-first FPS companion for Sodium or VulkanMod. Keeps players/pearls/arrows/crystals visible, cuts explosion clutter + hurtcam, culls mobs hard — no combat cheats, no chunk-meshing conflict.

custom.frameboost:note: Do not run Sodium and VulkanMod together. FrameBoost works with either renderer.
